robots:
# Refer Labs Robots.txt

# ── All crawlers ──
#
# Note on Disallow vs noindex: a page must be CRAWLABLE for Google to read its
# noindex tag. Disallowing a page that also carries noindex means Google can never
# see the directive, so an already-indexed URL can never be dropped. Pages below
# that carry noindex in their metadata are therefore deliberately NOT disallowed
# here: /login, /referred,
# /roi-calculator (301), /security, /integrations + children.
#
User-agent: *
Allow: /
# Private / authenticated (no content to index; auth-redirects before render)
Disallow: /dashboard/
Disallow: /dashboard-test/
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /auth/
# Internal / utility pages (dev checklists, tools - no public SEO value)
Disallow: /go-live
Disallow: /status
Disallow: /analytics
Disallow: /application
Disallow: /calendly
# Personalised referral links (redirect out to affiliate destinations)
Disallow: /r/
Disallow: /me/
# Payment flows
Disallow: /payment/

# ── AI / generative answer engines (GEO) ──
# Explicitly allowed to crawl and cite Refer Labs content. See /llms.txt for a curated index.
# Disallow list is IDENTICAL to the `*` group above: the same private/utility paths,
# and, like `*`, the noindex pages (/login, /referred) are deliberately left
# crawlable so any
# engine with an index can see the noindex and drop them, rather than being blind to it.
User-agent: GPTBot
User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
User-agent: ChatGPT-User
User-agent: ClaudeBot
User-agent: Claude-Web
User-agent: anthropic-ai
User-agent: PerplexityBot
